job_openings.title: Senior Software Engineer
job_openings.description: Design and deliver internal HR and finance platforms, mentor junior engineers and own service reliability.
job_openings.requirements: BSc in Computer Science or related field, 5+ years experience with TypeScript and PostgreSQL, strong API design skills.

job_openings.title: Payroll Accountant
job_openings.description: Own monthly payroll computation, statutory filings with RRA and RSSB, and reconciliation of payroll ledger accounts.
job_openings.requirements: Bachelor degree in Accounting, CPA Part 2, 3 years payroll experience, deep knowledge of Rwandan PAYE and RSSB rules.

job_openings.title: Production Supervisor
job_openings.description: Supervise the second shift production line, enforce safety standards and report daily output.
job_openings.requirements: Diploma in industrial engineering, 2 years supervisory experience in manufacturing.

job_openings.title: Customer Experience Officer
job_openings.description: Handle inbound client requests across phone and email, maintain the service knowledge base.
job_openings.requirements: A0 in business administration, excellent Kinyarwanda and English communication.

job_openings.title: Marketing Officer
job_openings.description: Plan and execute brand campaigns across digital and field channels.
job_openings.requirements: 2 years digital marketing experience, portfolio of campaigns.
